subject: Cortexly trial — post-demo next steps, POC success plan, and exec readout playbook
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ng <alex.ng@cortexly.ai>
Cc: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@cortexly.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Demo recap — alignment on next steps

Alex / Jamie — appreciate the time today. Quick follow-up notes and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before I draft the POC plan: 

Summary of what we heard on the call
- Primary goal: reduce triage time for support agents by surfacing suggested resolutions and summarizing long thread context.
- Key constraint: PII must never leave Cortexly’s VPC for the trial; customer data will be redacted within the test set.
- Success will be judged on both latency and accuracy (relevance of suggested resolutions).

Proposed POC scope (first pass)
- Dataset: 2 months of anonymized support tickets (~6k messages).
- Paths to validate: (1) agent suggested-responses (top-3), (2) auto-summaries for escalation threads, (3) reranking of KB articles.
- Duration: 4 weeks (2 weeks ingestion + 2 weeks evaluation).

Owners & asks
- Cortexly: provide anonymized dataset + technical contact for S3/VPC access (Alex).
- Redwood: deliver prebuilt connector, baseline model run, and metrics dashboard.
- Legal/Procurement: we’ll need an MSA/SOW for the trial covering data controls and retention.

Immediate next steps
1) Alex — confirm dataset availability and redaction approach by EOD Tuesday (2028-05-06).
2) Alex/Jamie — share an initial list of 5 critical success scenarios (ticket examples) by Wed (2028-05-07).
3) I’ll circulate a POC plan draft and metrics template once I have those inputs (target by Fri).

I’ve attached a one-page outline and a metrics template to speed reviews. If that timing works, I’ll lock calendar times for the kickoff next week.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

[Attachment: redwood_metrics-template.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)]

From: Alex Ng <alex.ng@cortexly.ai>

Cc: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@cortexly.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap — alignment on next steps

Sounds good, Olga — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers: 

- Dataset: we can provide a 6k-ticket export with automated redaction (PII tokens replaced). Our infra lead (cc’d) will confirm the S3 bucket access model.
- Success scenarios: we’ll share 6 concrete tickets (two escalation, two routine, two KB-related) by Wed morning.
- Timing: 4 weeks total is doable; can we start ingestion next Monday (2028-05-13)? That gives our infra team time to prep.

One additional ask from our side: we need an expected latency SLA for suggested-responses under the trial load (p95 target). Do you have a recommended threshold to validate UX acceptance?

—Alex
Alex Ng
Head of Product, Cortexly
alex.ng@cortexly.ai | +1 (720) 555-0199

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ng <alex.ng@cortexly.ai>
Cc: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@cortexly.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Demo recap — alignment on next steps

Alex — perfect, thanks. Latency guidance and refinement on metrics below. Also looping in Marissa to confirm exec readout sequencing and contract path.

Suggested POC success metrics (proposal)
- Accuracy / relevance: top-3 suggested-response acceptance rate >= 62% across sampled tickets (human raters).
- Summaries: average rouge-L >= 0.38 against our internal summaries on the sample set.
- Latency: p95 suggestion latency <= 450ms with the trial throughput (approx 12 reqs/sec).
- Regression checks: no more than 3% of cases flagged as hallucinations on manual review sample.

Evaluation plan & checkpoints
- Week 0 (prep): access, redaction verification, connector run (2 business days).
- Week 1: baseline model run and metrics report.
- Week 2: iterative tuning and re-runs.
- Week 3: holdout evaluation, UX sampling and manual QA.
- Week 4: readout prep and final metrics pack.

Ownership
- Redwood: infra/setup (Olga), model tuning (SRE + Applied ML), metrics dashboard.
- Cortexly: data access, sample validation, UX raters for acceptance.

Attachments: I pushed an updated metrics sheet with the proposed thresholds. Please review and call out any hard constraints.

If that looks good to you, I’ll publish the POC plan and send a calendar invite for kickoff week (2028-05-13).

—Olga
[Attachment: redwood_metrics-template.xlsx (updated)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Alex Ng <alex.ng@cortexly.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@cortexly.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap — alignment on next steps

Hi all — quick note from a readout and contract sequencing perspective:

1) Exec readout: we typically schedule a 30–45 minute decision window with the Cortexly exec team in the week after the final metrics are ready. Recommend we tentatively book Thu 2028-05-31 10:00–10:45 PT for the readout (Olga will send invite). That gives team time to digest the Week 4 pack.

2) Decision criteria for go/no-go: Marissa’s checklist
- Meets threshold for acceptance-rate and latency (as Olivia proposed).
- No unresolved security/data-control items flagged by the security review.
- Commercial terms: procurement receives the draft SOW and signals green on trial terms (30 day demo, limited liability clause).

3) Contract path: if exec approves, we’ll move to a short-term SOW amendment to the MSA; procurement (Cortexly) to confirm minimal redlines within 7 business days.

Olga — happy to join the readout if we see an exec window. Vivek — fyi on the account strategy and potential expansion into the support-product org.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Mid-Market Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — alignment check from our side:

- Dataset access: infra will grant the S3 role next Monday (2028-05-13).
- Success scenarios: shared (Alex sent examples); we agree to the proposed thresholds but would like a 1-week buffer before the exec readout in case of tuning.
- Readout timing: Thu 2028-06-07 10:00–10:45 PT works better for our VP of Support. Can you hold that slot?
- Procurement: looping in procurement@cortexly.ai to start the SOW review; they have a small template that will need the Redwood SOC/controls section filled in.

We will review the POC plan when you publish it. Also — attaching our internal trial checklist for reference.

Next steps (agreed)
1) Olga: publish final POC plan (inc metrics) by Fri 2028-05-10.
2) Infra: grant S3 access on 2028-05-13.
3) Marissa/Redwood legal: prepare SOW draft after initial trial run metrics (aim to have a draft by 2028-06-10 if readout is 2028-06-07).

Attachments: Cortexly_trial-checklist.pdf

—Jamie
